name: tree
title: Tree
description: A virtualized, keyboard-navigable tree following the ARIA treeview pattern: nodes with icons and trailing meta, lazy children with per-node loading and error-with-Retry rows, single selection, an action on Enter or double-click, type-ahead and a filter; only the visible rows are rendered.
usage: Use Tree for a hierarchy the user browses and opens: DBee's connections and schema browser (connection, schema, Tables and Views, table, columns), a file list. Pass nodes ({ id, label, icon, meta, children, hasChildren, loading, error, disabled }); load children when onExpandedChange reports a node opened (set loading, then children or error) and retry in onRetry; open the node in onAction (Enter, double-click); filter with filter (the text of a SearchInput above it). Give it a height (h-full in a sized panel): it scrolls and renders only what is visible, so thousands of nodes stay fast. Wrap it in a ContextMenuTrigger for node actions, using the selected node. For a few levels of navigation links use Sidebar; for a flat list, a listbox (Select, Combobox).

props.name: nodes
props.description: The top-level nodes; a TreeNode is { id, label, icon?, meta?, children?, hasChildren?, loading?, error?, disabled? }.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded node ids (controlled); defaultExpanded when uncontrolled.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when a node opens or closes; load its children here.

props.name: selected
props.description: The selected node id (controlled); defaultSelected when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called when a click or Space selects a node.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Enter or a double-click on a node: open it.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry loading a node's children: Enter on its error row, or the Retry button.

props.name: filter
props.description: Shows only nodes whose label contains the text, with their ancestors expanded; it filters loaded nodes, it does not load.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows rendered beyond the visible ones.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when there are no nodes (or none match the filter).

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes; give the tree a height.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="tree", the scroll container and the focus target (aria-activedescendant); data-slot="tree".

slots.name: chevron
slots.description: The expander, turned while open; data-slot="tree-chevron".

slots.name: loading
slots.description: The row under an expanding node while its children load (aria-busy); data-slot="tree-loading".

slots.name: error
slots.description: The row under a node whose children failed to load, with the message in color.status.danger.fg and Retry; data-slot="tree-error".

parts.name: TreeItem
parts.description: A node's row: role="treeitem" of size.control.sm with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded and aria-selected, indented by level; Tree renders one per visible node.

states.name: active
states.description: The row the keyboard is on: the focus ring while the tree has keyboard focus.

states.name: expanded
states.description: An open node's chevron turns a quarter.

states.name: hover
states.description: A row under the pointer: color.interactive.hover.

states.name: disabled
states.description: A node that cannot be selected: color.fg.disabled, aria-disabled.

accessibility: The tree is role="tree" named by aria-label and is one tab stop; the active row is named by aria-activedescendant (always rendered, even when scrolled away), so virtualization does not move DOM focus.
Rows are role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize and aria-posinset (the tree is flat in the DOM), aria-expanded on parents, aria-selected, aria-disabled and aria-busy while loading.

ArrowDown and ArrowUp move; ArrowRight opens a node or moves to its first child; ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent; Home and End go to the first and last row; typing jumps to the next node starting with the text; Space selects; Enter runs onAction (or Retry on an error row).
A loading row says so in text and an error row shows the message and Retry; Retry is out of the tab order because Enter on the row retries.
Selection uses color.interactive.selected and aria-selected; the focus ring shows only on keyboard focus.
Only the chevron turns; prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns that off.
